title: Agent-Wise Test-Time Normalization for Camera-Based Cooperative Perception with Corrupted Collaborators
abstract: arXiv:2610.39505v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Intermediate-fusion cooperative perception lets a vehicle detect objects beyond its own field of view by fusing features shared by nearby agents. When only a collaborator's cameras are degraded by fog, motion blur or exposure errors, the features it shares drift away from the training distribution while the ego input stays clean, and cooperation can become worse than not cooperating at all. Test-time batch-normalization adaptation, the standard training-free remedy, estimates statistics over the pooled batch of all agents and therefore normalizes both the clean ego and the corrupted collaborator with a mixture of two distributions. We show that this mixing harms even the clean ego: when the ego shares BN statistics with a corrupted collaborator, its detection from its own features drops by 3.58 to 6.68 AP@0.5 points although its cameras are untouched. translated_title: 面向存在受损协作者的相机协同感知的智能体级测试时归一化
translated_abstract: 中间融合协同感知使车辆能够通过融合附近智能体共享的特征来检测自身视野之外的物体。当仅有协作者的相机因雾、运动模糊或曝光错误而退化时，其共享的特征会偏离训练分布，而自车输入保持干净，此时协同感知的效果可能比不协同还差。测试时批归一化适配作为标准的免训练补救方法，是在所有智能体的合并批次上估计统计量，因此会用两种分布的混合来同时归一化干净的自车和受损的协作者。我们证明这种混合甚至会损害干净的自车：当自车与受损协作者共享BN统计量时，即使其相机未受任何影响，其基于自身特征的检测性能也会下降3.58至6.68个AP@0.5点。我们提出了AgentNorm，一种智能体级的测试时归一化方法，它i) 估计归一...
tldr: 提出AgentNorm，一种智能体级的测试时归一化方法，通过避免干净自车与受损协作者的特征统计量混合而相互污染，在协作者相机因雾、运动模糊等退化时仍能保持可靠的协同感知性能。
en_tdlr: AgentNorm, an agent-wise test-time normalization, prevents the clean ego vehicle's features from being contaminated by mixed statistics shared with corrupted collaborators, maintaining reliable cooperative perception when collaborators' cameras are degraded by fog, motion blur, or exposure errors.
